main kal school jaavaanga
tusin kiven ho
mera naam harpreet hai
assi saare ghar vich baithe si
aaj bahut garmi hai
ki tusin chaah peeoge
bacche bahar khed rahe ne
maan ne roti banai
mainu punjabi sikhni hai
eh kitaab bahut changi hai
asin amritsar ghumman gaye si
bazaar vich bahut bheed si
mere bhra canada rehnde ne
kal meeh pai sakda hai
gaddi station te late aayi
uhne mainu phone keeta
sade pind vich ik vadda khoo hai
tusin kitthe kamm karde ho
mainu thodi der lagegi
eh sadak bahut lambi hai
saadi dukaan savere khuldi hai
kuddi ne gaana gaaya
pitaji akhbaar parh rahe san
asin raat nu film vekhi
mera phone kharab ho gaya
doctor ne davai ditti
kheta vich kanak pakk gayi hai
oh hamesha time te aunda hai
sanu jaldi chalna chahida
ajj school di chhutti hai
mainu bhukh lagi hai
tusin is shehar vich nave ho
uhde kol navi car hai
asin vyah te gaye si
dadi ji kahaniyan sunaunde san
eh kamra bahut thanda hai
bijli phir chali gayi
main tuhanu kal milanga
saare dost park vich mile
chaa vich khand ghatt paao
